Regentatlantic Capital Increased Holding in Canon (CAJ) by $1.21 Million as Stock Value Declined; Aflac (AFL) Position Lifted by Sigma Planning Corp
June 14, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
Sigma Planning Corp increased its stake in Aflac Inc (AFL) by 80.45% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sigma Planning Corp bought 8,450 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.09% with the market. The institutional investor held 18,954 shares of the accident &health insurance company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $829,000, up from 10,504 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sigma Planning Corp who had been investing in Aflac Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $35.36B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.13% or $0.06 during the last trading session, reaching $45.68. About 3.14M shares traded. Aflac Incorporated (NYSE:AFL) has risen 21.38% since June 14, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 8.81% the S&P500.
Regentatlantic Capital Llc increased its stake in Canon Inc (CAJ) by 27.72% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Regentatlantic Capital Llc bought 33,545 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.70% with the market. The institutional investor held 154,544 shares of the miscellaneous company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.63M, up from 120,999 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
